tldr: Saturn in Aries: discipline must be learned through courage and self-direction.
body: With Saturn in Aries, Saturn is in fall, so discipline and initiative start out at odds; the work is developing initiative without recklessness and authority without constant combat. Patience becomes the tool that makes courage sustainable.
gift: Self-command, mature leadership, and the ability to act with restraint instead of fear.
challenge: Blocked assertion, harshness, or forcing independence because vulnerability feels unsafe.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
